title: Doozy Vape Co Doozy Legends Bubbly 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Juicy, sweet and achingly nostalgic, this classic Bubblegum flavour e-liquid from Doozy Vape’s Legends collection will reawaken memories of carefree days gone by. A delightful all-day vape and a juice that will put a smile on your face with every vape. This convenient 100ml shortfill bottle really helps your favourite e-liquid go the distance and comes with 25ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape’s nicotine content to your exact preference. For example, adding 2 x 10ml, 18mg nic shots will create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. This e-liquid’s 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , mods and sub-ohm tanks .
